infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required so users can participate in live mentorship sessions, audio calls, and send voice messages.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Eyeconic Mentorship uses the camera for live mentorship video calls, for example to share your video with your mentor during a session, and to monitor you during a quiz when AI proctoring is enabled, to help maintain exam integrity. Proctoring runs only while you are attempting a proctored quiz.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Eyeconic Mentorship to access your photo library so you can attach images to chat messages or add images to quiz content. For example, you can select a study diagram from your library and send it to your mentor in a chat.
